authority.scope: Validate GTK2 controls and the Theme Lab controller in isolated private Xvfb/bwrap fixtures; no user-session installation.

diagnosis.failure: Detached GTK2 preview reopening after Undo/Redo failed in the previous fixture when the GTK2 child attempted MIT-SHM XShmAttach.
diagnosis.cause: The test runner starts Xvfb outside bwrap, then launches GTK2 inside bwrap --unshare-ipc. The server and client consequently do not share the IPC namespace required by MIT-SHM.

api_probe.meaning: Calling Gdk.set_use_xshm(False) after GTK initializes does not disable the active XShm path in this setup.

change.scope: For GTK2 controller fixtures only, launch the fixture-owned Xvfb with MIT-SHM disabled. Keep bwrap --unshare-ipc enabled. GTK2 uses the regular X image path in this test fixture.

tests.method: Temporary runner copy with MIT-SHM disabled only on its disposable Xvfb server.
tests.scope: Full GTK2 combo controller sequence including detached close/reopen, project Undo/Redo, resize, Save/Load, restart and preserved pending edits.

tests.method: Repository runner with the GTK2-only Xvfb fixture adjustment.
tests.scope: Same full GTK2 combo controller sequence; coupled and detached native GTK2 combo both measured 300x50 after Apply; GTK2-only selection and project history behavior remained intact.

limits: This fixes a private test-fixture mismatch; it does not change production preview behavior.
The GTK2 recipe remains partial. Historical held-state comparisons for left, right and up, full coupled-control audit and user visual review remain open.
No evidence here establishes historical visual fidelity or authorizes installation into XChat or the user profile.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: The prior repeated-detached-preview lifecycle gap is now covered through Undo/Redo, Save/Load and controller restart in the GTK2 fixture. This is technical coverage, not a visual-fidelity score.
